description: This PHP source file defines the CalendarSyncJobFactory class, responsible for creating and managing scheduler jobs related to calendar synchronization within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for obtaining schedulers, creating account and meeting jobs, and handling job submission to the queue.

classes.name: CalendarSyncJobFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing scheduler jobs related to calendar synchronization.

methods.name: getScheduler
methods.description: Retrieves the scheduler instance that matches the specified conditions, returning null if not found or if an error occurs.

methods.name: createAccountJob
methods.description: Creates and submits a job for the specified calendar account, returning the job ID or null.

methods.name: createMeetingJob
methods.description: Creates a meeting synchronization job based on the provided CalendarSyncOperation, returning the job ID or null.

methods.name: createBaseJob
methods.description: Creates and initializes a base SchedulerJob with default properties, returning the job object or null.

methods.name: submitJob
methods.description: Submits a job to the job queue and returns its ID or null if the submission fails.
